sourceInconsistencies.source: 3.6 Health and welfare - VET Teaching Program TEMPLATE.docx
sourceInconsistencies.finding: The filename is numbered 3.6 but the internal source task title reads 'Task 6 – Care for health and welfare of livestock'.
sourceInconsistencies.handling: Use stable ID hsc-3-6 for navigation, preserve the source title separately and require PI-TC-02 before local task numbering is adopted.

sourceInconsistencies.source: TASK 22 Handle and observe livestock- VET Teaching Program TEMPLATE.docx
sourceInconsistencies.finding: The source states unit code ACHLSK224 for 'Handle livestock using basic techniques'.
sourceInconsistencies.handling: Preserve ACHLSK224 as source-stated, flag source_code_warning and require PI-TC-03 before formal RTO or enrolment use.

sourceInconsistencies.source: Task 3  - Operate tractors & machinery - VET Teaching Program TEMPLATE.docx
sourceInconsistencies.finding: The filename refers to tractors and machinery while the internal task title reads 'Task 3 – Operate tractors'; the source maps both AHCMOM202 and AHCMOM304.
sourceInconsistencies.handling: Use the neutral navigator label 'Task 3 — Tractors and machinery' while preserving the internal source title and both source unit relationships.

sourceLimitations: All 22 source Registration columns are blank.
Teaching Strategies cells are blank or contain only a direction to the teacher to add or integrate strategies and resources.
The source programs therefore support curriculum mapping and workflow architecture, but not a claim that ready-to-run practical, formative or assessment activities were supplied.
NESA indicative-hour values are source metadata and must not be copied into local planned or actual hours without PI-TC-01 confirmation.

selectionPolicy: Include every exact current 2026 Cert II Agriculture program source from the verified program extract.
Include non-controlled shared 2026 teaching resources, selected AHCv9 references, generic authenticated professional-learning recordings and the NESA keywords reference.
Keep direct and containing-folder URLs exactly as captured; both require departmental sign-in.
Publish filename/path metadata only. Do not copy source file contents into the public dataset.
exclusionPolicy: Exclude inventory-controlled or potentially sensitive records, private or answer-adjacent metadata, zero-byte records and unreviewed photos/images.
Exclude Archive, Past Exams, Evidence Central feedback and AHCv8 legacy areas.
Exclude superseded 2025 programs, other qualifications, Stage 5, event/operational material and low-confidence wider areas.
residualRisks: The inventory crawl classified metadata and did not inspect the contents of most linked files. Departmental sign-in remains the access control.
A publicMetadataSafe value of true applies to the displayed filename/path metadata, not to unrestricted republication of file contents.
AHCv9 reference files and recordings are hidden by default and require a teacher currency check before use.
Specific chemicals, machinery, livestock, biosecurity, farm-access, work-placement and safety procedures remain Teacher/RTO to confirm.
The source-typed ACHLSK224 code and the Task 3.6 internal-title inconsistency remain unresolved source issues; this curation does not silently correct them.

visualCoverage.justification: This is a teacher-only authenticated-file navigator and delivery-program site, not a student learning-package build. Republished photography would be decorative, could create rights/privacy risk and would not teach an in-scope student concept. Existing Staffroom visuals remain authenticated pointers only.
